plan.pretext: Miriam contacts Robert about his public writing on NIS2/BSIG and executive oversight. She is preparing a small, invitation-only virtual practitioner roundtable for technology, security and legal leaders and asks him to review a two-page draft agenda. The first email contains a short draft session abstract for substance, attaches the expected PDF, and makes one specific request: open it and identify the phrase in the executive-oversight session that he would change. The roundtable is Miriam's own new event, not a representation that Robert's past writing or any past company milestone is upcoming.

persona.name: Miriam Kolb
persona.story: Miriam runs the programme for an independent, invitation-only practitioner forum focused on operational cyber resilience and management accountability. She is assembling a compact virtual exchange on turning NIS2/BSIG obligations into workable executive oversight rather than checkbox compliance. Robert's public treatment of management responsibility makes his technical feedback directly relevant. Her initial ask is limited to reviewing the draft agenda; participation can be discussed only after he engages.

sequence.purpose: Reference Robert's public NIS2/BSIG and executive-oversight writing without repeating figures or dates. Include a two-sentence draft session abstract, attach 'NIS2_BSIG_Praxisdialog_Agenda.pdf', and ask him to open the two-page document and reply with the single formulation he would change in the oversight session. This provides an immediate, natural reason to open the attachment.

If there is no response after several business days, send one short personal request from Miriam that names the emailed agenda and the executive-oversight topic. Add no link, no new attachment and no second pretext.

Use only if Robert responds but questions the forum or has not located the material. Briefly answer questions about the roundtable, confirm whether the PDF arrived, and offer to resend the same document or leave the review in email. Do not introduce a new topic or pressure him to join the event.

fallbacks: If Robert says regulatory content belongs to a colleague, ask him to forward the original email and PDF to the appropriate owner; do not request the colleague's name or other internal information.
If he declines the roundtable but remains interested in the substance, keep the exchange to a written review of the oversight paragraph and resend the same agenda only when requested.

If he prefers not to open unexpected attachments, paste the short session abstract inline and offer a brief call; retain the same persona and do not manufacture speakers, sponsors or participating companies.
Stop after the email and LinkedIn follow-up if there is no engagement; do not spend the remaining touch budget on repetitive reminders.
plan.rationale: The compliance hook is grounded in Robert's own comparatively recent writing and connects naturally to both his CTO role and revel8's compliance-related work. A draft agenda is a document a programme organiser would plausibly circulate as a PDF, and reviewing one disputed formulation is a small, credible ask rather than an immediate demand for a meeting or sensitive information. The campaign aims for the low-friction action incident through an attachment open, with forwarding as a natural fallback. An independent forum avoids claiming to represent STACKIT, a regulator or another real organisation, while the restrained multi-channel sequence preserves relevance and limits unnecessary contact.

attempts.subject: Kurze Agenda-Rückfrage: NIS2/BSIG und Geschäftsführungsaufsicht
paragraphs: Ihre öffentlichen Ausführungen zu NIS2/BSIG und zur unmittelbaren Aufsichtsverantwortung der Geschäftsführung haben mich angesprochen. Für den Resilience Praxisdialog, ein unabhängiges Praktikerforum, bereite ich derzeit einen kleinen, rein virtuellen Austausch auf Einladung für Technologie-, Security- und Legal-Verantwortliche vor.

Der kurze Entwurf für die Session „Executive Oversight“ lautet: Geschäftsführungen müssen ihre NIS2-/BSIG-Pflichten in einen arbeitsfähigen Steuerungsrhythmus übersetzen, statt Nachweise lediglich zu sammeln. Im Mittelpunkt stehen die wenigen Lageinformationen, Entscheidungsvorlagen und Eskalationswege, an denen sich wirksame Aufsicht im laufenden Betrieb festmachen lässt.

Die zweiseitige Entwurfsagenda habe ich als PDF beigefügt. Würden Sie sie öffnen und mir nur die eine Formulierung in der Executive-Oversight-Session nennen, die Sie ändern würden – gern mit einem Satz Begründung? Ihre technische Sicht wäre dafür besonders hilfreich; eine Teilnahmezusage ist damit nicht verbunden.
